name: socialapp
description: SocialApp - Threads/X style social network. Standalone Node.js/TypeScript API (Railway + PostgreSQL) and an installable Windows Electron desktop client.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:packages && npm run prisma:generate
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @socialapp/shared && npm run build -w @socialapp/api-client
scripts.build:server: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @socialapp/server
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @socialapp/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @socialapp/shared && npm run typecheck -w @socialapp/api-client && npm run typecheck -w @socialapp/server && npm run typecheck -w @socialapp/desktop
scripts.package:win: npm run build:packages && npm run package:win -w @socialapp/desktop
